pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-polygonal dark regions characterized by sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries and high edge angularity. Relative spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the upper flank and mid-neck, becoming smaller and more clustered towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous reticulum of light-pigmented negative space forming a interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-functional. Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank with high pixel continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck. The mane is composed of dense, dark-pigmented hair creating a jagged 1D geometric contour against the background.
